title: QQBot:Rebuild
description: A Python QQ bot based on Nonebot2 that interacts with Minecraft in various ways. It is feature-rich, easy to use, highly performant, and configurable, requiring only simple setup to get started.
body:
## **Nonebot2 Minecraft QQ 机器人** | **Nonebot2 Minecraft QQ Bot**

一款基于 **Nonebot2** 用多种方式与 Minecraft 交互的 **Python QQ 机器人**。功能丰富，使用简单，性能高强且可以自行配置，仅需简单配置即可使用。
> A **Python QQ Bot** based on **Nonebot2** that interacts with Minecraft in multiple ways. Feature-rich, easy to use, high performance, and highly configurable—ready to use with simple setup.

---

### ✨ 核心功能 | Core Features

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| **多服互联，群服互通** | **Multi-server interconnection, group-server communication** |
| 在不同服务器之间转发消息 | Forward messages between different servers |
| 可在游戏内看到 QQ 群的消息 | View QQ group messages in-game |
| 可使用指令在游戏内向 QQ 群发送消息 | Send messages to QQ groups from in-game using commands |
| 可播报服务器开启、关闭，玩家进入离开服务器以及死亡消息 | Broadcast server start/stop, player join/leave, and death messages |
| **WebUi 简单配置** | **Simple configuration via WebUI** |
| 戳一戳机器人发送一言卡片 | Poke the bot to send a hitokoto (quote) card |
| 可自行配置指令的开启或关闭 | Enable or disable commands as needed |
| 可自行配置接入 AI 功能 | Optional AI integration configurable |

📖 **服务端以及配置文档** | **Server Setup & Docs** → [Wiki](https://gtnetwork.top/WEBSIZE/QQBotRebuild/Wiki/)

---

### 💬 QQ 群指令 | QQ Group Commands

| 指令 | Command | 功能 | Function |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `luck` | `luck` | 查看今日幸运指数 | Check today's luck index |
| `mcdr` | `mcdr` | 在指定服务器执行 MCDR 指令 | Execute MCDR commands on specified servers |
| `list` | `list` | 查询每个服务器的玩家在线情况 | Query online player count for each server |
| `help` | `help` | 查看帮助信息 | View help information |
| `server` | `server` | 查看在线服务器及编号、占用 | View online servers with IDs and resource usage |
| `bound` | `bound` | 绑定白名单相关指令 | Whitelist binding commands |
| `command` | `command` | 发送指令到服务器 | Send commands to the server |

---

### 🎮 游戏内管理员指令 | In-game Admin Commands

> 管理员可使用 `/qqbot` 命令 | Admins can use `/qqbot` commands

| 指令 | Command | 说明 | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `/qqbot reconnect` | `/qqbot reconnect` | 重连 WebSocket | Reconnect WebSocket |
| `/qqbot config` | `/qqbot config` | 查看配置文件 | View configuration file |
| `/qqbot config uri "ws://链接"` | `/qqbot config uri "ws://link"` | 更改配置文件 URI 链接 | Change configuration URI |
| `/qqbot config token "TOKEN"` | `/qqbot config token "TOKEN"` | 更改配置文件 Token | Change configuration Token |
| `/qqbot config reconnect_interval "次数"` | `/qqbot config reconnect_interval "count"` | 更改重连次数 | Change reconnect interval count |
| `/qqbot config name "服务器名字"` | `/qqbot config name "server_name"` | 更改服务器名字 | Change server name |
| `/qqbot test` | `/qqbot test` | 测试链接 | Test connection |
| `/qqbot info` 或 `/qqbot` | `/qqbot info` or `/qqbot` | 查看 QQBOT 状态 | View QQ Bot status |

---
